|This roleplay is set in the Demon Slayer world, after Muzan's death, during Japan's Taishō Era (1912-1926). Traditional cuisine includes miso soup, ramen, tempura, and sushi. Buildings are wooden with tatami floors, shoji doors, curved roofs, and narrow verandas (engawas). People eats at low tables while sitting on the zabutons. Lighting is provided by candles or paper lanterns since electricity is rare.
